#### Veeam

**Configuration**

This dashboard gives visibility into configuration-change events in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique users, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces the hosts and users that change backup, encryption, and related settings. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a configuration-change view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
